name: Greta Dubois
headline: Security Engineer
summary: Security engineer focused on embedded and platform hardening for robotics environments. Experienced in securing low-level software, tightening authentication flows, and improving defensive coding practices across product teams. Brings a practical approach to risk reduction, incident response, and secure implementation reviews.

roles.title: Security Engineer
bullets: Hardened device services in C and C++ on Linux, reducing crash-triggered faults by 27% and improving resilience under load.
Implemented OAuth login flows and session safeguards for operator tools, cutting account-related support issues by 33%.
Reviewed code and threat scenarios against OWASP guidance, closing 18 high-priority findings before release.
Built Python scripts to automate security checks and log review, saving about 10 hours per week for the engineering team.
